items.title: I'm gonna miss coding
items.summary:
Coding is dead and I'm gonna miss writing it by hand, but we have an incredible opportunity moving forward. Lets talk about it. 

Thank you Depot for sponsoring! Check them out at: https://soydev.link/depot
